term.label: sequence_variant_causing_amino_acid_coding_codon_change_in_transcript

definition.text: The DNA mutation affects the amino acid coding sequence of a gene; this region includes both the initiator and terminator codons.

comments: OBSOLETE: This term was deleted as it conflated more than one term. The alteration is separate from the effect.

synonyms.value: sequence variant causing amino acid coding codon change in transcript
mutaton causing amino acid coding codon change in transcript
